main_issue: How to complete the client pitch on time given Agent D's bereavement and partial section unfinished

A-B.evidence: A assigned the analysis to themself and asked B to review (Turn 9); B agreed to review tomorrow afternoon (Turn 10).

A-C.evidence: C initially said they couldn't do D's section and needed to finish their own (Turn 5), then later committed to start slides after finishing by tomorrow morning (Turn 19).

A-D.evidence: D offered to finish the section that night (Turn 6) and A rejected relying on that (Turn 7); by the end D conceded and left it to the team (Turn 20).

B-C.evidence: Both declined to take on D's full section initially (B: Turn 4; C: Turn 5) and later accepted complementary roles under A's plan (B: will review, Turn 10; C: will start slides after finishing, Turn 19).

B-D.evidence: B said they couldn't take on more (Turn 4) while D offered to do the work (Turn 6); later B agreed to review (Turn 10) and D stepped back, leaving it to the team (Turn 20).

C-D.evidence: D offered to do the analysis (Turn 6) and later worried about extra work for others (Turn 15); C reassured the team they'll finish their part and help with slides (Turn 17 and Turn 19).
